mode: Transparent raster generation and localized editing
portable_inputs: Source/*.png; export_frames.py reads these included files, not cache paths
notes: Turnarounds are references only; they are not runtime sprites.
The Support UR and UL source sheets were separately generated using corrected view descriptions.
Support_Active_R.png contains only the accepted upper eight frames of its original mixed sheet; rejected UR rows are excluded.
No frame rotation, mirroring, duplicated still gait, or procedural anatomy deformation is used.
